doc.projectIntro: This quote covers a 100Mbps connectivity service for Plane Talking, together with the once-off network installation: a compact 6U wall rack, PoE switch, network-point cabling and installation labour. Payment is online by card — the once-off installation plus a pro-rata portion of the current month is paid at checkout, and the monthly service fee is then billed automatically on the 1st of each month. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Compact 6U desktop/wall-mount rack for the network equipment.
10-port switch with 8 PoE ports and a 115W power budget.
Cable and materials for the network points.
Racking, cabling, switch configuration and commissioning.
100Mbps service, billed monthly. Your first month is charged pro-rata from three days after checkout (allowing for installation); thereafter the full monthly fee is billed on the 1st.

doc.summaryNote: Checkout is online by card: you pay the once-off installation plus a pro-rata portion of the current month now, and R 2,300.00 incl VAT is then billed automatically to the same card on the 1st of every month until cancelled. The three days between checkout and the start of billing allow for installation at no charge.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Payment is by card at checkout: the once-off installation plus a pro-rata charge for the current month, calculated from three days after checkout to month-end.
The monthly connectivity fee is billed automatically to the same card on the 1st of every month until cancelled.
The connectivity service is month-to-month; cancellation requires one calendar month's notice.
Installation is scheduled once payment is received.
Hardware remains the property of Rocking until paid in full.
